title: Core Color Palette
slide_intent: Distinguish a palette’s working grounds from the accent that interrupts them. Viewers can then see what deserves attention.
strategic_value: Kale and Cashew can establish a recognizable everyday contrast, while Carrot provides a concentrated accent tied to the symbol.
demonstration: Three overlapping color circles label Kale, Carrot and Cashew. They cross a background divided into pale and dark halves, with a usage explanation at left.
practical_value: Choose Kale and Cashew for text and surfaces, then use Carrot to emphasize a detail against them.

content_islands.name: Role guidance
content_islands.spec: Set the heading and usage explanation at the upper left of the light field.

content_islands.name: Palette specimens
content_islands.spec: Stack three large overlapping circles to the right across the two-tone background. Label their names and screen values inside each specimen.
